hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.pl|*.pm|*.t|*.psgi|*.pod) ;; *) IFS= read -r first < "$f" 2>/dev/null; case "$first" in '#!'*perl*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac ;; esac; pc=$(command -v perlcritic || echo /usr/bin/vendor_perl/perlcritic); out=$("$pc" --quiet "$f" 2>&1) && exit 0; printf 'perlcritic (%s):\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
